column1: # Source: written for this pack (GPL-3.0-or-later), no third-party data. Expected traces are this pack's transform ids, newest first.
# Test files run with every optional processor on (addMissingFada), so the negatives leave out words that processor reads as another word; those are in defaults.tsv.

# Constraint rows: each fails when one stem constraint of the named transform is deleted (sources/README: Measurements, mutations). Most sources are words of the Irish Wikipedia or UD Irish-IDT; the rest are built from the rule's ending.
